--- tail ledger ---
  bcAmb K S on CommAlgCat K is a LEFT ADJOINT to restriction of scalars
  (hom-equivalence = Algebra.TensorProduct.liftEquivRight, naturality by
  TensorProduct.induction_on); left adjoint => PreservesColimitsOfShape
  WalkingSpan; S1745 closedness gives Creates/Reflects for the inclusion of
  finite etale algebras; then WalkingCospan^op ~ WalkingSpan turns pushout
  preservation into pullback preservation for the opposite functor.  Note:
  flatness of S is NOT needed in this direction (it is only relevant to left
  exactness of tensorProd); the Under.pushout left-adjoint fact in
  Mathlib/Algebra/Category/Ring/Under/Limits.lean is the CommRingCat-level
  analogue, and the direct CommAlgCat adjunction was chosen because
  commAlgCatEquivUnder.inverse does not compose definitionally with mkUnder.
- S1822 evidence: tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1822BCPullbacksActual.lean, 15189 bytes
  SHA256 53A718404B4EF1B87D3FDEDBB49D855F9CCB54AD4E6CF0609E3196DB350B6AEA;
  EXIT=0; olean 586816 bytes SHA256
  630DE9C72F13AE54ABACA6908412BC1C746E38DC8034D7DB9CBE30249E2444B4 (also
  copied to .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/); axioms
  propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only, no sorryAx.  Provides
  S1822.S1769_BCPreservesPullbacks : S1769.BCPreservesPullbacks K (the hPull of
  S1769.fiberFunctorOf) and the general field-extension version
  S1822.baseChange_op_preservesPullbacks.  Caveat for consumers: S1794's
  PreservesPullbacksField is stated for an arbitrary field Omega, but its
  reduction route (fiberIsoBaseChangeFiber + fiber Omega Omega being an
  equivalence) needs IsSepClosed Omega; the geometric point Omega =
  AlgebraicClosure K is fine.

S1839 (2026-11-01): the S1828 universal slice filling is FALSE (counterexample,
not a proof).
- S1828SliceFillsOver (every Over(Spec F') morphism S1733Model A -> S1733Model B
  is over Spec R') cannot be derived from the S1755/S1816/S1744 model-map
  constructions.  Those give only the one-directional statement that every
  extraction value S1755ModelHomOfCoverMap A B f is over Spec R'
  (S1812ModelHomOfCoverMap_triangle, restated as S1839ExtractionOverBase), not
  that every model morphism is an extraction value.
- Counterexample: the terminal (identity) cover S1762TerminalCover has chosen
  finite-etaleness S1762IdentityFiniteEtale, whose identity-point base-change
  presentation is the identity square.  Hence
  S1733Model S1762TerminalCover = S1726AffineOver and
  S1733ModelOver S1762TerminalCover = 1, both by rfl (S1839TerminalModel,
  S1839TerminalModelOver).  At this pair the filling triangle forces every
  endomorphism of Spec R' over Spec F' to be the identity.  But the F'-point
  (0,0) gives a constant F'-algebra endomorphism tau of
  R' = F'[x,y]/(y^2 - x^3 - (61/64)x^2 + (125/64)x) with tau(x) = 0, while
  x != 0 in R' (witnessed by the F'-point (1,0), which sends x to 1).  Thus
  g = Spec tau is a non-identity endomorphism of Spec R' over Spec F', and the
  filling fails (S1839TerminalFilling_false, S1839_not_sliceFillsOver).
- Consequences: g is not the extraction of any cover map
  (S1839NotExtractionImage), hence not S1755ModelHomSurjective and
  not S1755ModelHomEquivMissing are PROVED unconditionally
  (S1839_not_modelHomSurjective, S1839_not_modelHomEquivMissing).  With
  S1755SourceRetraction, S1828's dictionary also gives
  not (S1828SliceFillsOver and S1766CoverMapDiscrete) (S1839_fillingConj_false).
  Therefore S1828R1ModelCategory has a refuted hypothesis: R1 for
  S1733ModelCategory cannot be obtained from h + hd through the filling.  The
  slice-corrected S1828R1 (S1828ModelOverCategory) is unaffected.
- Evidence: tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1839SliceFillingActual.lean, 13841 bytes
  SHA256 D65A58A8739DBDC7770EA42AD75B2B6B7BA2DC588FD08548CB6F4573CA38C282;
  EXIT=0; olean 105632 bytes SHA256
  5ECB810BDC78500F084CA27AB6040442341634C3722814752CFED74341E34ED5; axioms
  propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only, no sorryAx.  Report:
  coord/reports/S1839-slice-filling-counterexample.md.
